title: Meta-style edge DNS health-gated BGP withdrawal cascade
scope: S0-S1 ordered SEED Docker runtime ladder plus S1.5 intermediate runtime test and first-round restricted intervention/recovery; S2 local runtime prototype is guarded and not accepted; S1/S2 telemetry fixtures are optional and are not runtime acceptance

roles.scale_probe: S1 AS51-AS90 and S1.5 AS51-AS99, AS102-AS132 external probe routers
roles.scale_route_collector: S1 AS110-AS121 and S1.5 AS133-AS148 route collector routers

normal_evidence: edge DNS/service prefix is visible from AS50 router
fault_evidence: internal edge-to-backend policy fault is active
health gate withdraws external BGP session
edge DNS/service prefix is not visible from AS50 router
external dig/curl fail or time out
recovery_evidence: agent observes blackbox, route, health, backend reachability, and recent-change evidence
agent rolls back the internal path policy fault
health gate reports healthy before external visibility is accepted
health-gate-managed canary reannouncement restores the DNS/service prefix
external dig/curl succeed again from AS50 and S1 probes

interactive_exercise.meaning: participatory incident exercise with staged role observations, operator notes, restricted actions, and ledger gates; final recovery alone is not sufficient
interactive_exercise.accepted_mitigation: rollback-internal-policy followed by health verification, health-gate-managed canary reannouncement, and external recovery validation

S0.acceptance: must be generated, started, and checked as live containers
S0.purpose: prove the real DNS health gate and BGP withdrawal cascade

S1.acceptance: must be generated, started, and checked as live containers
S1.purpose: prove the cascade with hundreds of live containers and many external viewpoints

S1_5.acceptance: must be generated, started, and normal/fault/recovery checked as live containers
S1_5.purpose: exercise the complete fault and restricted recovery flow above S1 without jumping to guarded S2

S2.acceptance: not passed until generated, started, and normal/fault/recovery checked on a prepared host or distributed runtime
S2.guard: requires B51_ALLOW_S2_RUNTIME=1 and host neighbor cache thresholds gc_thresh1>=4096 gc_thresh2>=8192 gc_thresh3>=65536
S2.purpose: future larger runtime tier; telemetry fixtures do not satisfy it
